Hi team,

Quick handoff: we closed Medoria Health (RWI-3421) yesterday. High-level context and asks below so CS/Implementation can pick up without waiting on me. Please confirm owners and a kickoff window this week or early next.

Deal summary
- ACV: $1.2M/year (hosted API + dedicated reserved pool for inference)
- Go-live target: 2028-09-15 (pilot -> phased rollout)
- Key contacts: Alicia Grant (Procurement/Exec sponsor), Medoria Health Technical (engineering lead)
- Compliance: customer requested SOC 2 attestation and audit log retention details — sales provided SOC docs; CS may need to coordinate evidence for procurement.

Expectations / success criteria
- Pilot (30 days): endpoint availability for two clinical internal teams; latency SLO < 300ms p95
- Expansion (60–90 days): integrate dedicated pool + KV cache settings; automated prefix caching for common prompts
- Billing: meter usage; committed reserved capacity kicks in at expansion stage

Immediate asks for CS/Implementation
1) Confirm primary CS owner and implementation lead.
2) Schedule 60-minute kickoff with customer (suggest 48–72 hour window) — include security/IT contact from Medoria.
3) Review SOW (attached) and confirm any redline items before DocuSign.
4) Ops: allocate staging namespace and ephemeral cluster for pilot testing; share access matrix.

Attachments: Medoria_SOW_v2.pdf, MVP-Implementation-Roadmap.xlsx
HubSpot/DocuSign links below.

Notes for internal use (sales): customer is sensitive about data residency in the US and wants keys managed via their KMS if we go private. They expressed interest in reserved capacity but asked for a cost/comms plan for burst traffic. Alicia will coordinate procurement timeline.

Thanks — I can join the kickoff if useful for the intro.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
